prompts.text:
A 12-second vertical 9:16 rags-to-riches mini soap opera in a glossy 3D animated cartoon look, like a modern animated feature film: smooth stylized shapes, soft detailed fur, big expressive eyes, rich warm colors and soft cinematic light, with clear cuts like a cat story on TikTok.

The main character is the pet in [Image 1] as a 3D cartoon cat person, in every shot: an adult cat that walks upright on two legs, wears clothes and acts like a person, with the head and face of the pet in [Image 1] so its owner recognizes it at once: the same face shape, ear shape, eye color, fur colors, markings and patches in the same places, fur length and whiskers. The paws, arms and tail have the same fur. The same face and coat in every shot, never a generic white cartoon cat. If [Image 1] shows a dog or another animal, the main character is that animal in the same way, with its own face, fur and markings. Exactly one main character: never a second copy of it.

Everyone around is an adult cartoon cat in everyday clothes. The rival is an original fat, smug cat with cream fur and a thin moustache in a shiny purple suit; its coat is clearly different from the main character's.

0-3 s: a rainy night street in a small town. The main character, thin and tired, in a worn hoodie with patches, pushes a little wooden cart of grilled fish skewers through the rain. The rival drives past in a big open sports car with no badge and splashes it with puddle water, laughing. The main character wipes its wet face, looks into the camera and says softly: "One day, you will see."
3-6 s: a sunny morning market. At its little stall the main character grills fish skewers and hands them to a long line of happy cat customers; coins fill a glass jar; it smiles for the first time.
6-8 s: its own bright fish restaurant, full of guests. The main character, in a clean white chef's jacket, counts a stack of plain banknotes at the counter, grinning.
8-12 s: night, in front of the glittering restaurant with warm golden lights. The main character steps out of a long white car in a sharp tailored suit. The rival, now waiting in the long line at the door, drops its jaw. A slow push-in to a close-up of the main character: a big proud smile into the camera: "I told you."

Audio: an original dramatic soap-opera tune, soft and sad in the rain, swelling to a big happy finale, with rain, sizzling fish, market chatter and a car door. Only the two spoken lines, by the main character.

Every character is an adult cat or the animal from [Image 1]: no kittens, no babies, no children and no humans anywhere. Everyone wears modest everyday clothes. They are original cartoon characters, not existing cartoon, film or game characters. No brand names, no logos, no monograms, no stripes or emblems on clothes, no car badges, no readable writing on signs, shops, money, phones or screens: signs show only pictures. No text, no subtitles, no captions, no watermark.
